Name: Loxsly's Fishing Net
Author: Loxsly
Description:
Loxsly's Fishing Net
[b]Automate your fishing, expand your fishing empire, and turn the waters of Stardew Valley into a reliable source of fresh fish![/b]
Loxsly's Fishing Net introduces a craftable, late-game fishing net that automatically catches fish native to the waters where it's placed. Unlike traditional Crab Pots, these nets can catch regular fish based on their location, season, and weather conditions.
Whether you're fishing along the beaches of Pelican Town, the mountain lake, or exploring the expanded fishing locations of [b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/b], these nets offer a convenient way to supplement your fishing income.
Designed to integrate with [b]Automate[/b], the mod allows you to connect fishing nets to your existing automation network for automatic baiting and fish collection.
[heading]Installation Instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer and the latest compatible version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download the compiled Loxsly's Fishing Net release.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]directory, or install through a compatible mod manager such as Vortex.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Craft your first fishing net and place it in a suitable body of water![/*]
[/list][b]Optional Mods:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Automate[/b] – Automatically supplies bait and collects caught fish.[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] – Change fishing speed and other settings directly from the game's menu.[/*]
[*][b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/b] – Compatible with expanded fishing locations and fish registered through the game's fishing data.[/*]
[/list][heading]Crafting Recipe[/heading]
Fishing Nets are designed as a more expensive, late-game alternative to Crab Pots.
[b]Crafting requirements (1 Fishing Net):[/b]
[list]
[*]1 Cloth[/*]
[*]1 Iridium Bar[/*]
[*]1 Fishing Tackle (any type)[/*]
[/list]The crafting recipe unlocks at Fishing Level 3, though the Iridium Bar requirement makes the item more practical for established farms.
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
Automatic Fishing
Place your fishing nets in water, supply them with bait, and let them do the work! Nets catch regular fish appropriate to their location, with seasonal and weather conditions taken into account.
Configurable Catch Speeds
Choose how frequently your nets attempt to catch fish:
[list]
[*][b]Overnight (Default):[/b] 1 fish per day[/*]
[*][b]10 Hours:[/b] Up to 2 fish per day[/*]
[*][b]4 Hours:[/b] Up to 5 fish per day[/*]
[*][b]2 Hours:[/b] Up to 10 fish per day[/*]
[/list]Each net holds one catch at a time. For faster settings, Automate is recommended to continuously collect fish and free the net for additional catches.
Stardew Valley Expanded Compatibility
Loxsly's Fishing Net is compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded and supports fishing locations that register their fish through Stardew Valley's fishing data.
A configurable freshwater fallback is included for custom farm maps, including Immersive Farm 2 Remastered, where fishing-location data may be incomplete.
Full Automate Integration
Connect your fishing nets to chests and other compatible automation equipment to create an automated fishing operation.
Automate can supply bait, retrieve catches, and transfer fish into storage without requiring manual collection.
Custom Animated Graphics
Fishing Nets feature custom animated artwork, replacing the traditional Crab Pot appearance with a distinctive fishing-net design.
Customizable Fishing Options
Customize the fishing experience through Generic Mod Config Menu or the mod's configuration file.
Available options include:
[list]
[*][b]Garbage Collection:[/b] Enable or disable catching trash.[/*]
[*][b]Treasure:[/b] Enable or disable automatically generated bonus treasure.[/*]
[*][b]Legendary Fish:[/b] Allow or prevent legendary fish from being caught.[/*]
[*][b]Fishing Speed:[/b] Adjust how frequently nets produce fish.[/*]
[*][b]Freshwater Fallback:[/b] Enable additional freshwater fishing support for custom farm locations.[/*]
[/list]Easy Placement and Retrieval
Place nets in suitable water tiles and retrieve them using [b]Shift + Right-Click[/b].
Nets can be repositioned, and their contents are preserved when collected.
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[b]Required:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.x[/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b]
[list]
[*]Automate by Pathoschild[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded by FlashShifter[/*]
[/list][b]No Content Patcher installation is required.[/b] Loxsly's Fishing Net is packaged as a standalone SMAPI mod in a single folder.
[heading]Important Notes[/heading]
[list]
[*]Fishing Nets require bait to operate under normal conditions.[/*]
[*]Faster fishing settings work best when paired with Automate.[/*]
[*]Fish availability depends on the fishing data registered for each location.[/*]
[*]Custom maps without complete fishing data may use the optional freshwater fallback.[/*]
[*]Legendary fish are disabled by default.[/*]
[*]Treasure and garbage collection can be customized independently.[/*]
[*]Existing placed nets are designed to persist between game sessions.[/*]
[/list][heading]Shout Outs & Credits[/heading]
Special thanks to:
[list]
[*][b]ConcernedApe[/b] – For creating Stardew Valley.[/*]

[*][b]FlashShifter[/b] – For Stardew Valley Expanded and its expanded world.[/*]
[*][b]spacechase0[/b] – For Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[/list][b]Created by Loxsly[/b]
Enjoy a more automated fishing experience, and happy farming!
